description: AS 203959 hijacked prefix 172.81.129.0/24, which is a more-specific prefix within the legitimate block 172.81.128.0/21 owned by AS 46664. The attacker AS 203959 announced this more-specific prefix, causing traffic destined for 172.81.129.0/24 to be routed to the attacker's network instead of the legitimate owner AS 46664. Reference cases show AS 203959 has a history of similar prefix hijack incidents in 2015.
